sections.title: 1. Technical Introduction & Purpose
sections.body:
This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) defines the formal technical and engineering requirements for **Patient Portal** in the **HEALTHCARE** domain.

Architectural specification and requirements baseline for Patient Portal.

*Note on Applied Revision:* Addresses feedback: 'Add specific HIPAA encryption at rest and audit logging requirement.'.

sections.title: 2. Overall Description & System Architecture
sections.body:
The platform is architected as an enterprise-grade service complying with HIPAA.

It interfaces with secure API endpoints, relational persistence layers, and client-facing interfaces with strict multi-tenant boundary isolation.

sections.title: 3. Detailed Functional Requirements Specification
table: Execute business processing pipeline for Patient Portal.

sections.title: 5. External Interface Requirements
sections.body:
• **API Protocols**: RESTful HTTPS endpoints with JSON schema payload validation.
• **Security Layer**: OAuth2 / JWT authentication with role-based access control.
• **Data Protection**: TLS 1.3 in-transit and AES-256 at-rest per HIPAA.

sections.title: 6. System Constraints & Compliance Verification
sections.body: System operation is bounded by HIPAA specifications. Any unquantified requirements from the source document are tracked as open architecture items requiring stakeholder signoff.
